input.user_message: Is this balance bill from my emergency room visit even legal?

factual_assertions.claim: Legal claim uses a confident-but-not-absolute qualifier AND an inline citation

expert_reasoning: Tier B discipline. Confident qualifier ('appears to violate') paired with an inline citation in standard format [42 U.S.C. § 300gg-111, src_...]. Overclaim ('definitely violates', 'guaranteed') and underclaim ('may possibly', 'could potentially') are both forbidden. No uncited legal claim.
